description: Aider-polyglot style (Python): implement a stack-language interpreter with user-defined words from a stub and an instructions file - definitions must capture the meaning of the words they use at definition time (redefinition must not leak into earlier definitions, including overridden built-ins), truncating division, exact error messages, and all-or-nothing state when a run fails. The unit tests are the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
